suggest.importDependence: Check whether the imported goods can be produced on the island, or bought through cheaper routes.
suggest.exportConcentration: A single dominant export exposes the income to price swings and route changes: develop a second or third export.

ui.theAlmanacAndTheAdvisorOf: The Almanac and the advisor of your island
ui.outputStorageOfTheProducersA: Output storage of the producers (a missing level in the save means empty). Island stock counts every stock of the resource. Exported: last 12 months.
ui.workmodeAndBudgetLevelAreThe: Workmode and budget level are the most common ones in the class. Fill is the average fill of the output storage.
ui.depositsInUseAreEstimatedEach: Deposits in use are estimated: each producer is matched to the nearest deposit of its resource. Amounts are the initial ones (deposits did not deplete in the saves analysed).
ui.standingIsTheSumOfThe: Standing is the sum of the modifiers stored in the save. Leader and corruption effects are not stored, and the absolute scale is unverified: compare factions with each other and look at the sign. History is the net of past positive and negative events.
ui.onlyTopicsWithANonDefault: Only topics with a non-default choice are stored.
ui.incomeIsOnlyTheDirectIncome: Income is only the direct income (visitor fees and rents). Producers earn through exports, so a low income is not a loss.
ui.stockIsTheTotalOverEvery: Stock is the total over every stock of the resource. Price change compares the last price sample with the earlier average (sample order unverified). Routes: exports offered / imports offered.
